mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month indicates strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the previous two months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST declines by more than 10%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% over the previous two months signals a strengthening supply side, boosting economic growth and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals strong consumer demand coupled with a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer demand and tight labor market
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increases by more than 1% and UNRATE is below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% year-over-year, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy in a slowing economy
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS is above 3% and GDPC1 YoY growth is below 2%.
